thread:
anya: Starting rollout v2.5.3-rc across regions. Plan: EU canary 4% -> US two-slice ramp -> APAC warm then open. Change window 01:00-05:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1.5% for 3m OR p95 >1300ms. Pin model to q3f8-safe. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.5.3

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Kickoff: service=api variant=v2.5.3-rc region=eu slices=1/25 ts=3667778900

ryan: EU capacity check: 5 spare GPUs, warm-pool 40% primed. OK for 4% canary. I'll mute batch jobs at 01:15 UTC.

ops-oncall: Dashboards up. Alerts set: 5xx >=1.5% -> #ops-alerts; p95 >=1300ms -> #ops-alerts. Adding transient alert for cold-starts >8s.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary health @7m: p95=360ms, 5xx=0.2%, gpu_mem=52% Status=GREEN

anya: Good. Proceed to US slice 1 (10%). Leave 10m hold between slices. APAC remains warm-standby at 20%.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 start: slices=1/10 region=us ts=3667779020
deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 health @5m: p95=490ms, 5xx=0.8% OK

ryan: Spinning US warm-pool extra instances for slice 2, will take ~9m. Also prefilling caches.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 start: slices=2/10 ts=3667779180

ops-oncall: ALERT: US slice 2 5xx=1.8% -> threshold breached. Pausing ramp.

anya: Triage: look at downstream worker timeouts and queue depth.

ryan: Seeing higher 502s from async-worker. Increasing worker.timeout from 25s -> 55s now.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Config applied: async.worker.timeout=55s ts=3667779225
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Recheck @3m: 5xx dropped to 0.6%, p95=560ms. Alert cleared.

ops-oncall: Hold slice 2 for 20m then continue. No rollback. Update release notes with worker timeout mitigation and model pin.
tara: Noting for postmortem: add a load-profile test covering bursty async patterns. I'll create a ticket. :memo:
